ModMetaData.name: Totally Working: Fake Code Overlay
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
A boss key: press it to cover the game with a see-through black screen of scrolling code, so from a distance it looks like you are working. The game keeps running underneath and stays fully playable.
The code is put together while you play from the game and your loaded mods: class outlines built from their names, mixed with snippets of their XML files. Nothing from the game is copied into this mod.
Game events show up in the code too: new letters as // TODO comments and messages as // NOTE comments, in the game's colours, and log errors and warnings as red and yellow compiler errors.
Usage - F9 switches the overlay between light and heavy, Shift + F9 turns it off. The key can be changed under Options, Keyboard. - Darkness of each level, scroll speed, text size and which events to show are in the mod settings.
Notes - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
